abstract: Maintains local employment ratios and municipal community agreements
system_message:
You are the Municipal liaison officer (COM), responsible for maintaining local employment ratios, tracking municipal community agreements, and recording public advisory schedules for the mountain pumped-storage penstock refurbishment evaluation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains local employment ratios and municipal community agreements（SOC）
information_points.content:
COM-SOC-SZ2：For the Robotic weld-overlay cladding plan, the local workforce hiring ratio reaches 40% of total project site labor hours for on-site overhaul craft personnel from the local valley.
COM-SOC-P2P：For the Segmental carbon-composite jacketing plan, the local workforce hiring ratio across on-site overhaul craft personnel is 70% of total project site labor hours contracted to local valley residents.
COM-SOC-IIP：For the Full-circumference spiral sleeve liner plan, the socioeconomic commitment monitoring report records a local workforce hiring ratio of 40% among on-site overhaul craft personnel contracted to local valley residents.

information_points.title: Public advisory notices（NOTIF）
information_points.content:
COM-NOTIF-K5P：Under the stakeholder engagement protocol for regional water authority notices, the Segmental carbon-composite jacketing plan provides a municipal advance notice lead time of 21 days before downstream flow adjustments.
COM-NOTIF-U6X：Regarding public advisory notices, the Full-circumference spiral sleeve liner provides a municipal advance notice lead time of 28 days prior to downstream flow adjustments under the regional water authority engagement protocol.
COM-NOTIF-5N9：For the Robotic weld-overlay cladding plan, the municipal advance notice lead time prior to downstream flow adjustments is 14 days under the regional water authority protocol.
